column4: Trace and correct the device-churn interpretation when its kernel uevent delta includes source-signed self-probes. Evidence from 2026-09-14: the pass ending 05:25:05Z reported delta=84 and the 05:26:04Z udev summary matched seqdelta=84/seq-total=10921, with 83/84 events signed as mesh-devcd-catch probes and one unsigned hwmon event; device-churn nevertheless boarded this as a real enumeration burst. The next pass ending 05:30:02Z had delta=102 but only 84 retained udev rows (81 signed mesh-devcd-catch, 3 unsigned, 18 sequence events absent from that bounded stream), so missing evidence must remain unknown. Implement a source-aware classification that prevents confirmed signed probe events from being described as external enumeration, while preserving genuine unsigned events and unknown coverage gaps; do not subtract a ratio or blanket-suppress deltas. Add regression fixtures for both the exact complete-match and incomplete-stream cases. Run the narrow tool test, syntax/wiring checks, and a read-only live check; record evidence and hashes. No radio, routing, firewall, service, or external-device action.
